scripts.test:strict: bun run test && bun run typecheck
scripts.build:bundle: bun build src/app.ts src/benchmark-worker.ts src/audio-worklet.ts src/inference-worker.ts src/coi-serviceworker.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --splitting --minify
scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist/ort && cp index.html styles.css dist/ && cp node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/*.wasm dist/ort/
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run test:strict && bun run build:bundle && bun run build:assets
scripts.check:dist: test -f dist/app.js && test -f dist/audio-worklet.js && test -f dist/inference-worker.js && test -f dist/coi-serviceworker.js && ! find dist -type f -name '*.ts' -print -quit | grep -q .
